tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support the siphon-memory ODE, but the five rows are insufficient to establish that its fitted parameters generalize. The trajectory batch adds constraints on the transient dynamics; the pilot horizons already bracket the target horizon of 0.46.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint measurements provide no redundancy and may not distinguish the memory timescale from coupling and slow decay.
Neither model accounts for the observed transient lag or uses the initial state and memory.
It does not help identify the coupled dynamics.
